name: branding-dark-olive-app-icon-close-up-and-store-card
title: Olive App Icon Close-Up and Store Card
whatItIs: Two dark panels: a phone corner with the olive-gradient house-and-leaf icon labelled Homely, and a frosted store listing with the icon, Get button and ratings, over a green glow.
whatItMeans: The gradient icon glows on black, and the store card proves it works in a real context.
techniques: Macro phone corner as a framing device
Olive gradient tile with a white line mark
Green glow rising from the corner
Rating, age and chart stats row

vocabulary.definition: An app-store card with icon, name and rating.
A logo drawn with a uniform stroke.
Light emerging from one corner of a frame.
